_meta.description: Generic transport mode speeds, capacities, and requirements for travel-time estimation. A campaign may override or extend these: if TRANSPORT_SPEEDS.json exists in the campaign directory, its transport_modes and stamina_requirements entries are merged over this file (campaign wins per entry).
_meta.notes: Use for calculating unknown routes. Always defer to canonical route times when available.

foot.name: Walking/Marching
foot.notes: Base human/humanoid travel speed. A party typically travels as a group at this pace.

burden_lizard_caravan.name: Burden Lizard Caravan
burden_lizard_caravan.notes: Slower than foot but carries massive cargo. Traditional Vaarn transport.

cargo_crawler.name: Cargo Crawler (Pre-Collapse Vehicle)
cargo_crawler.notes: Reliable but slow. Good for supply runs.

hoverbike.name: Hoverbike (Pre-Collapse)
hoverbike.notes: Fast personal transport. Speed +8 means wear helmets.

ornithopter.name: Ornithopter (Titan Aircraft)
ornithopter.notes: Fastest reliable transport when one can be found and fueled.

time_conversion.notes: Bell system corresponds directly to hours. Bell 1 = 1 AM, Bell 24 = Midnight
